{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for LOYAL customers with completed orders
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
loyal_completed['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(loyal_completed['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check how many rows have NaN in revenue after conversion
invalid_count = loyal_completed['revenue'].isna().sum()
print(f"Number of invalid revenue rows among LOYAL completed orders: {invalid_count}")

# Drop rows with invalid revenue
valid_loyal_completed = loyal_completed.dropna(subset=['revenue'])

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = valid_loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of a completed order from LOYAL customers: {mean_revenue}")

# Return the values for use in submit_answer
invalid_count, mean_revenue"}
